title: Your Name

research
I work on corporate finance and financial intermediation, with an empirical focus on hand-collected contract data. Recent projects examine sponsor commitment mechanisms and reputation in SPAC markets.

title: Research
text:
Working paper



Sponsor commitment and SPAC outcomes

Abstract PDF SSRN


Using manual extraction of lock-up agreements and sponsor capital commitments from 1,525 SPAC prospectuses filed between 2006 and 2024, we test whether financial commitment mechanisms discipline sponsor behaviour.
